mapper.select: select d.id, d.name, d.description, d.ipv4, d.infer_freq as inferFreq, d.max_source as maxSource, d.hardware_version as hardwareVersion, d.software_version as softwareVersion, d.status, d.source, d.ship_id as shipId, s.name as shipName from device d left join ship s on d.ship_id = s.id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
